📌 Tehran, IRNA – Chief Commander of the Islamic Republic of Iran Air Force Brigadier General Bahman Behmard has pledged that the force will remain fully committed to defending the Iranian nation against any aggression by its “sworn enemies” while following the Leader of the Islamic Revolution.

In a message issued on Thursday to commemorate the anniversaries of the martyrdom of Major General Abbas Babaei and Major General Hossein Lashkari, Behmard stressed the importance of preserving the memory of the two prominent Air Force figures and continuing their path in safeguarding Iran’s dignity and strength.
​
“We assure the nation that, in the path of obedience to the Leader and defense of the great Iranian nation against the aggression of the sworn enemies of this homeland, we will remain legitimate heirs and self-sacrificing followers,” he said.
​
Behmard described the middle of the Iranian calendar month of Mordad as a period that recalls “the names and memories of sincere men whose combat uniforms became the garments of martyrdom.”
​
He praised Babaei as a humble military genius whose legacy remains etched in Iran’s history, while describing Lashkari as a symbol of freedom for future generations.

Crypto Idea

Long-Term investing strategy

When the crypto market is falling, buying feels scary. When it's going up, it feels like you've already missed your chance.

As a result, most people either buy based on emotion or keep waiting for the perfect entry point — and end up doing nothing at all.

But there's a simple way to avoid this problem: invest a fixed amount of money at regular intervals.

This strategy is called DCA (Dollar-Cost Averaging).

You simply choose the asset, the amount you want to invest, and how often you want to buy.

For example:
$50 worth of Bitcoin every week.

When Bitcoin is cheaper, your $50 buys more. When it's more expensive, it buys less. Over time, your average purchase price naturally evens out, and over the course of a few years, it often ends up being better than the average market participant's.

Bybit even has a built-in Auto-Invest bot designed specifically for this strategy. You set it up once — choose your currency, the coin, the investment amount, and the schedule.

After that, your purchases happen automatically, whether it's every day or once a month. The key is to choose a coin you genuinely believe in for the long term.
